column2: Retain completion of prayer, heavenly fire consuming both offering categories and glory filling the house. The fire and glory remain distinct narrated phenomena.
Retain the priests unable to enter at that time because glory filled the house. Do not reduce this to inability to stand, the different wording in chapter 5.

Retain all Israel seeing the descent and glory, falling upon the stone pavement, worship and praise, followed by neuter it is good and enduring mercy. Three display lines distinguish narrative and the two selected poetic clauses.
column3: The neuter good retains the same open interpretive question as the chapter 5 praise; no silent He is good replacement is made.

column2: Retain king and all people sacrificing before the Lord. The participial construction receives an English finite were without an invented number of offerings.
Retain 22,000 calves and 120,000 flock animals and both king and people dedicating the house. Flock animals is broader than a silently specified sheep-only count.

Retain priestly watches, Levites' instruments associated with David, thanksgiving, enduring mercy, David's hymns through their hands, priestly trumpets and standing Israel. Three display lines distinguish the narrative introduction, selected praise clause and its surrounding description.
column3: The relationship of David to the instruments and hymns is left in the selected possessive construction; no explicit instrument-making verb is added.

column2: Retain consecrated court center, burnt offerings and salvation-offering fat there, and the altar's insufficiency for burnt offerings, manaa and fat. The opaque offering term is not guessed from a parallel.
column3: Manaa remains untranslated and unapproved; salvation/deliverance offering terminology also requires cross-book lexical consistency review.

column2: Retain seven feast days, all Israel and the geographical extent from Aimath's entrance to Egypt's torrent. No second duration is added within this unit.
Retain the eighth-day closing celebration and the selected single seven-day dedication-feast statement. Do not expand the clause to two expressly separate seven-day periods from another witness.
column3: The relation of dedication and feast and its chronology remain unresolved; closing celebration is provisional for exodion.

column2: Retain dismissal on month seven, day twenty-three, dwellings, rejoicing and good heart because of good done for David, Solomon and Israel. No twenty-second day replaces the selected date.
Retain completion of both houses and success of everything Solomon desired for them. Soul remains the seat of desire; no wider claim that every royal act prospered is inserted.
Retain God's night appearance, hearing the prayer and choosing this place as a house of sacrifice. No dream is supplied in the selected appearance account.
Retain closed heaven/no rain, locust devouring singular tree and death sent among the people. Do not substitute land for tree or an unexpressed pestilence term for death.

Retain shame, invocation of God's name over the people, prayer, seeking face, turning from wicked ways and the three divine responses of hearing, propitiousness and land healing. Do not replace shame with a reflexive humble themselves formula without review.
column3: The precise shame/turning/respect nuance of entrape and propitiousness toward sins remain lexical questions.

column2: Retain future open eyes and attentive ears for this place's prayer. The bodily attention imagery is not reduced to a generic promise of approval.
Retain chosen and sanctified house, enduring name and both eyes and heart there all days. Repeated now and enduring expressions remain rather than being compressed into one sentence of permanence.
Retain the singular address to Solomon, David as example, every commanded action and ordinances and judgments. Ordinary you correctly addresses a human within divine speech.
Retain establishment of Solomon's throne and the covenant quotation about a leading man not removed in Israel. No extra forever or explicit seated-on-throne clause is imported inside the quotation.
Retain the shift to plural you, turning away, abandonment, other-god service and worship. English you does not show the number change, so the distinction is recorded in this comparison.
Retain removing you plural from land given to them, turning the house from God's presence and making it a parable and tale among all nations. Do not silently harmonize them to you.
column3: The selected you/them shift and the house as the object of parable/tale remain open discourse questions.

column2: Retain this lofty house, every passerby's astonishment and the question about both land and house. Lofty is not emended into a ruin or rubble description.

Retain abandonment of the ancestral exodus God, attachment to other gods, worship and service, and the resulting calamity. The third-person explanation concludes the embedded future quotation without altering the divine speech frame.
Retain twenty years and both the Lord's and Solomon's houses, with the time clause continuing into the city building. Do not assign twenty years only to the temple itself.
Retain Chiram as giver of the cities to Solomon, their rebuilding and Israelite settlement. Do not reverse the gift direction to conform to Kings.
Retain Solomon's advance to Aimath Soba and prevailing over it. No additional battle details or treaty terms are supplied.
Retain Thedmor in the wilderness and the fortified cities in Emath. Fortified is the selected city description, not a replacement storage-city interpretation.
Retain Upper and Lower Baithoron with walls, gates and bars. The two settlements are not combined into a single unspecified fortification.

Retain Baalath, fortified cities, chariot and cavalry cities, repeated desire and the three geographical scopes Jerusalem, Lebanon and all the kingdom. The redundancy represents the selected emphasis.
Retain all five remaining non-Israelite groups and the opening of the explanatory parenthesis. No sixth nation is added to complete a different traditional list.

Retain descendants left in the land, Israel's failure to exterminate them and Solomon bringing them under tribute to this day. The parenthetical descent relation remains separate from the eventual labor/tribute action.
column3: Phoros in this labor context may include forced service; tribute is provisional and does not resolve the exact administrative form.

column2: Retain Israel's sons not assigned as servants to the kingdom, with warriors, rulers, mighty men and chariot/cavalry commanders listed instead. The contrast does not assert that Israelites had no obligations of any kind.
Retain 250 supervisor chiefs driving the people's work. Do not substitute a different superintendent figure from Kings or combine it with chapter 2's 3,600.
Retain Pharaoh's daughter moved from David's city to her house and the stated holiness of the ark-entered place. The quoted restriction concerns the city here, not a silently changed house of David.
Retain Solomon's burnt offerings on the altar opposite the sanctuary. The selected sanctuary relation is not replaced by porch solely from a parallel rendering.

Retain daily requirement, Mosaic command, sabbaths, months and the three named annual feasts. At the months preserves the selected noun rather than silently changing it to a different Greek new-moon term.
column3: The idiomatic English treatment of monthly observance remains open; this does not deny the lunar-calendar context.

column2: Retain David's ordinance, priestly service divisions, Levites' praise and service, daily requirement and each gate's divisions. David's man-of-God designation belongs to the source and is not newly inferred from the instructions.
Retain no transgression of royal commands concerning priests, Levites, any matter and treasuries. The negative scope covers all listed administrative areas.
Retain prepared work from the founding day until Solomon's completion. The initial founded subject is inferred as the house; no separate construction date is supplied.
Retain Gasion-gaber, coastal Ailath and Idumean land. No modern harbor identification is substituted for these selected places.

Retain ships and sea-skilled servants sent by Chiram through servants, joint voyage with Solomon's men, Sophira and 450 gold talents. Do not change to 420 or solve ship transport logistics by adding a journey not stated.
column3: The maritime sending construction and Sophira's precise geographical identity remain unresolved.
